# Grab3D candy models

The candy set and the separate swirl lollipop are by Grab3D and are dedicated
to the public domain under CC0 1.0. The accompanying LICENSE.txt is the source
package's license and origin notice.

- Candy set: https://grab3d.com/models/food/candy-set/
- Swirl lollipop: https://grab3d.com/models/food/lollipop/
- CC0 legal code: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

FBX geometry and the base-color and normal textures from each model's OBJ
package are used by the Unity URP materials. `UpgradeSecondIslandCandyArt`
fits the visuals to the existing decorations and keeps the scene collision.
